targeting_context.jd_text:
Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships
San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA

About Anthropic

Anthropic's mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As the Manager of the Partnerships Applied AI Solutions Architect team, you will drive adoption of frontier AI by enabling deployment of Anthropic's products (Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, API) through our Global and Regional System Integrators, cloud partners (AWS, GCP, Azure), and strategic technology partners.

You will build and lead a team of Partner Solutions Architects, establish processes and best practices for partner-led pre-sales engagements, and represent Anthropic as the technical lead on its most important partnerships. In collaboration with Sales, Partnerships, Product, and Engineering, you will help partners incorporate leading-edge AI into their practices, accelerate indirect revenue, and execute long-term GTM strategy while maintaining our best-in-class safety standards.

Responsibilities

    Team Leadership & Development: Hire, manage, and mentor a team of Partner Solutions Architects. Set goals, run reviews, and coach each team member toward high productivity and career growth.
    Strategic Technical Partnership: Act as the senior technical thought partner to Anthropic's GTM partnerships team. Co-build partner strategy with aligned GTM leadership, drive key programs, and align cross-functional stakeholders (Sales, Product, Engineering) behind partner outcomes.
    Partner Enablement & Ecosystem: Embed your team with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, troubleshoot, and evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities. Represent Anthropic at partner events (GSI workshops, AWS/GCP summits, hackathons) and contribute technical content and thought leadership.
    Joint Solution Development: Lead partners in identifying high-value, industry-specific GenAI applications. Develop joint solutions and codify reference architectures and best practices to accelerate time to deployment.
    Customer Deal Support: Own the technical portion of partner-led pre-sales engagements. Intervene directly on strategic deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep solution architecture guidance.
    Product Feedback: Gather and validate feedback on Anthropic's products from partner deployments and deliver it to Product and Engineering to inform roadmap and partner strategy.

You may be a good fit if you have

    7+ years in technical customer-facing or partner-facing roles (Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner SE, TAM).
    3+ years managing pre-sales or partner-facing technical teams; comfortable building foundational teams in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
    Track record building and scaling partnerships with GSIs (e.g., Accenture, Deloitte, TCS, Infosys) and/or cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure).
    Deep understanding of partner-led selling and delivery: indirect revenue models, enablement at scale, and joint GTM motions.
    Technical depth in enterprise AI deployments: LLM architecture, prompt engineering, evaluation, API integrations, and production use cases.
    Exceptional communication and executive presence; able to build trusted relationships with C-suite, partner leadership, and engineering teams alike.
    A love of teaching and mentoring, and a passion for advancing safe, beneficial AI.

Strong candidates may also have

    5+ years leading partner-facing SA teams through hypergrowth, including developing both senior and junior talent.
    Direct experience helping GSIs or consultancies build their AI/ML practice - enablement programs, certification paths, joint solution development.

Compensation

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role's On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary: $315,000 - $380,000 USD

# Anthropic - Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships briefing packet
| Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships | $315,000–$380,000 OTE | Reports to Partnerships / GTM leadership (partner-led enterprise adoption) |

## JD Complement
This is not simply a technical-management hire. Anthropic is formalizing the layer between frontier-model capability and repeatable enterprise implementation through external delivery organizations.

The operating tension is scale versus control: partners can multiply reach and implementation capacity, but Anthropic must preserve product quality, security expectations, responsible-use standards, and a coherent customer experience across
deployments it does not directly deliver.

## Company DNA & Operating Model
Anthropic is a San Francisco-based public benefit corporation and AI safety and research company. Its commercial identity is a hybrid of frontier-model provider, developer platform, and enterprise software vendor.

Its dominant enterprise motion increasingly depends on putting Claude into customer workflows through multiple routes: Claude for Enterprise, the Claude platform, API-based applications, and managed agent infrastructure.

The company’s differentiation is tied to reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. That makes implementation architecture a commercial and governance issue, not only a pre-sales exercise: partners need to create useful solutions
without misrepresenting model behavior or bypassing responsible deployment practices.

## Company Strategy & Operating Pressure
Anthropic is converting a research-led model business into an enterprise adoption system. That transition creates pressure to make successful deployments more repeatable across business teams, developers, and large implementation partners.

Claude for Enterprise is positioned around security, compliance, and business/developer use cases. Anthropic’s own enterprise deployment materials frame adoption as a four-phase process spanning technical setup, change management and
launch, rather than a standalone software activation.

The decision-rights tension is likely between central product and engineering teams, which own core platform behavior, and field or partner teams, which see deployment friction first. The valuable operating mechanism is a disciplined
feedback loop that turns recurring implementation patterns into enablement, product inputs, and reusable architectures.

## Leadership & Stakeholder Map
Anthropic was founded by former OpenAI researchers, including Dario Amodei and Daniela Amodei. Its public identity continues to combine research, safety, policy, engineering, and commercial work.

Relevant stakeholder groups include:
- Partnerships and GTM leaders shaping cloud, services, and technology-partner coverage.
- Product and engineering teams responsible for Claude products, API capabilities, and managed agent infrastructure.
- Enterprise and developer-facing teams responsible for secure adoption and implementation experience.
- Safety, policy, and responsible-use functions whose standards affect partner solution design and customer deployment boundaries.
- Cloud, technology, and services partners that extend market access and delivery capacity.

## AI, Data, Platform, Architecture Signals
Anthropic operates both an enterprise application surface and a developer platform. The Claude platform is positioned for creating agents and applications with frontier Claude models and managed agent infrastructure.

That architecture creates a practical divide that partner teams must bridge: business-user deployments, custom API integrations, and agentic applications may share a model provider but demand different governance, implementation, and
support patterns.

Claude Enterprise’s emphasis on security and compliance makes enterprise architecture conversations likely to include administrative controls, deployment readiness, adoption design, and operational ownership—not only prompts or model
selection.

Anthropic’s research positioning around reliability, interpretability, and steerability is material to solution design. Partners need patterns that translate those product principles into customer-facing use cases and deployment guardrails.

## Partnership / Ecosystem Motion
Partnership is material to Anthropic’s commercial model. Anthropic publicly describes a network of cloud, technology, and services partners intended to help customers address AI challenges.

The ecosystem motion is broader than referral selling:
- Cloud partners provide infrastructure, routes to market, and technical distribution.
- Services partners provide implementation capacity, change-management support, and industry context.
- Technology partners can embed or extend Claude within customer technology stacks.
- Enterprise deployment requires co-ordinated technical enablement, not just commercial account mapping.

Accenture publicly positions its Anthropic relationship around enterprise AI deployment, productivity, value creation, and new-product development. This signals a joint-solution and delivery-oriented model in which partners need credible
architectures, implementation methods, and escalation paths.

The central partnership challenge is to let partners lead enough of the customer journey to scale adoption while keeping Anthropic close enough to strategic technical decisions, product feedback, and implementation quality.

## Recent Events & Urgency
Anthropic’s public platform now emphasizes managed agent infrastructure alongside frontier Claude models. This raises the implementation bar for partners: customer conversations can move from isolated AI use cases toward more durable
applications and agent workflows.

The company has also made enterprise deployment guidance and adoption education publicly available. That indicates an effort to operationalize implementation knowledge rather than leave adoption entirely to bespoke field support.

As enterprise AI buyers move from experimentation to governed deployment, Anthropic faces pressure to make partner-delivered outcomes repeatable across security-conscious organizations while preserving its safety-centered brand.

## apps_rg Positioning Themes (targeting only, not proof)
- Building partner technical motions that convert platform capability into repeatable customer deployments.
- Scaling GSI, cloud, and technology-partner enablement without diluting architecture standards.
- Creating reference architectures and field feedback loops for API, enterprise, and agentic use cases.
- Leading technical teams across product, engineering, sales, and partner stakeholders.
- Treating enterprise adoption as technical setup plus governance, change management, and operating ownership.
- Balancing ecosystem velocity with responsible-AI, security, and customer-trust requirements.
- Supporting strategic deals while codifying reusable patterns that reduce dependency on bespoke intervention.

## apps_lic Outreach Angles (targeting only, not proof)
- Anthropic’s partner ecosystem spans cloud, technology, and services providers rather than a single-channel model.
- Claude adoption appears to require both technical implementation and organizational change management.
- The managed-agent platform direction increases the need for production-grade partner architecture patterns.
- Accenture’s public Anthropic deployment positioning makes joint delivery quality a visible ecosystem issue.
- A safety-centered company faces a distinct challenge in scaling third-party implementation without losing consistency.
- The most interesting partnership question is how Anthropic turns deployment learnings into better enablement and product decisions.

## Do Not Use As Proof
The JD and this briefing are targeting inputs only. Candidate claims, outcomes, scope, leadership experience, technical depth, and partnership results must come from the governed resume/proof graph.

Rubric dimensions (graph-only C0.3 augmented skills graph authority, non-SRFS lane):
1. factual_support: claims supported by allowed_fact_packet and candidate claim_ledger source_fact_ids only.
   **For rows carrying `display_override_text`, the authorized substrate is the UNION of `claim_text` +
   `display_override_text`. Phrases from `display_override_text` are deterministically authorized — do NOT
   flag them as unsupported, inferential, or out-of-scope extensions; the generator was X2-required to emit
   them verbatim. When `graph_proof_refs.claim_support_graph_refs` is non-empty, also authorize prose that
   demonstrates those skill nodes; `graph_proof_refs.source_resume_files` is authoritative provenance.
   Cite a `factual_support` failure only when prose deviates from the full authorized union (claim +
   override + graph skill refs).**
2. executive_signal: SVP-level platform/governance/partner-motion synthesis, not bullet stacks.
3. resume_voice: credible executive prose; no recruiter filler, meta narration, or generic AI-company prose, and nothing that would fail a Head of Talent Acquisition screen.
4. ats_alignment_without_keyword_stuffing: JD shapes emphasis only; no JD-as-proof. When allowed facts
   lack EA/interop/federated proof IDs, penalize only if prose invents those themes or ignores documented
   gap_notes — not for absence alone when generation_law_digest requires gap_notes. Reward company-DNA specificity when the
   packet supports partner ecosystem, adoption motion, commercial fit, or a clean Head of Talent Acquisition screen.
5. anti_overfit: no unsupported metrics/credentials; no target company as candidate experience; no repeated metric inventory
   or company-name mirroring; no AI-authenticity dead giveaways such as em dashes, buzzword soup, or template phrasing.
   **`display_override_text` content is NOT an unsupported credential/metric — it is X2-authorized
   substrate. Do not cite override phrases (e.g. "FSA-chartered", "informing data governance and AI
   strategy at scale") as anti_overfit violations.**
6. synthesis_quality: **exactly six** integrated sentences (X2 band); reward connective SVP IT strategy emphasis when
   ledger-backed; penalize thin recap S6, repeated metric surfaces, and bullet-stacked prose. **Do not** soft-penalize
   credential/metric inventory, unused_fact_ids weave targets, or mechanism dumps when the mapped deterministic gate shows `"pass": true`.
   Keep the cadence human enough to pass a Head of Talent Acquisition screen without machine-generated tells.
7. evidence_utilization: when `x2_exec_summary_evidence_utilization` is `"pass": true`, unused_fact_ids are optional weave
   targets — not proof gaps. Penalize under-use only when that gate is `"pass": false` or synthesis is decisively thin;
   reward distinct evidence themes instead of the same metric repeated in multiple sentences.
8. deterministic_alignment: **only** penalize gates that show `"pass": false` in deterministic_gate_summary. Never cite
   retired five-part/S1–S5 arc mandates when gates passed.

Residual quality (always in scope — not closed by X2 alone):
- executive clarity, narrative coherence, commercial fit, usefulness, unsupported phrasing outside ledger scope.

Decisive failure triggers (must align with deterministic_gate_summary failures when cited):
- unsupported business metric or credential (when x2 gates failed or decisive unsupported claim)
- JD or briefing used as proof
- first-person narrative
- obvious rewrite recommendation that invents new claims
